caption.es: Alekhine y Euwe sentados con autoridades en el club Phoenix de Delft el 12 de octubre de 1935, durante su match.
caption.en: Alekhine and Euwe seated with officials at the Phoenix club in Delft on 12 October 1935, during their match.
